title: png-alpha-benchmark-toolkit: Lossless ISO/IEC 15948 PNG Alpha-Channel Analysis, Scanline Filter Optimization & Cutout Matting Benchmark Suite
description: Open-source reference toolkit and empirical benchmark dataset for lossless ISO/IEC 15948 Portable Network Graphics (PNG) alpha-channel analysis, Paeth scanline filtering, and zero-alpha RGB sanitization. Official platform: https://toppng.com/
